Yes, this matches my intent. A quieter third tab keeps Archived discoverable without giving it the same prominence as the everyday views.

Archived bookmarks should remain completely separate from All and Read later, including their searches, while search, tags, and sorting continue to work within the archive itself. Restoring an item exactly as it was is also important.

The distinction between reversible archive and permanent deletion is now clear. I’m happy to move on to actions on multiple bookmarks.
